review_scope: Technical side-by-side review of 23 composed production views after intaking the native electrical enclosures and feed charts. Dark Harukiya and brick-only dumbwaiter views retain their baseline framing limitations. Separate installed views show the enclosures, panel branch and riser under declared review fill. The fuse-panel cover returned to the warmer appearance seen before the prior radiator mechanism review. The original fuse interaction failure is retained separately.
